title: Superficially
summary: SUPERFI'CIALLY, adverb On the surface only; as a substance superficially tinged with a color. 1. On the surface or exterior part only; without penetrating the substance or essence; as, to survey thing

inlines.v: SUPERFI'CIALLY, adverb On the surface only; as a substance superficially tinged with a color. 1. On the surface or exterior part only; without penetrating the substance or essence; as, to survey things superficially 2. Without going deep or searching things to the bottom; slightly. He reasons superficially I have laid down superficially my present thoughts.
